introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - Ordinary Level Examination. Computer Science (0595), Paper 3 (practical), June 2021. Duration: two and a half hours. Do all tasks (Task I, Task II, Task III) in this question paper.**

The booklet reproduced here contains three versions of the same practical paper, headed Group One, Group Two and Group Three (booklets GCE/P/2021/0595/3/C/Grp 1, Grp 2 and Grp 3). Each version has three tasks: Task I (word processing, 20 marks), Task II (spreadsheet, 20 marks) and Task III (reading and running a short C or Pascal program, 10 marks). A candidate works on one group only (the printed paper does not say how the groups are allotted).

Enter the information required in the shaded boxes. For your guidance, the approximate mark for each part of a question is indicated in brackets. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. All written answers should be provided in the spaces provided in this question booklet. Calculators are NOT allowed.

The working files named in the tasks (the picture 'CornerShop' found on the desktop, Group Two Task II) are supplied on the day; they are not reproduced in the printed paper.

incertitudes: Le PDF (18 pages, scan sans couche texte) contient TROIS versions du meme sujet pratique : « Group One » (pages 1 a 6, livret GCE/P/2021/0595/3/C/Grp 1), « Group Two » (pages 7 a 12, Grp 2) et « Group Three » (pages 13 a 18, Grp 3), chacune avec Task I (traitement de texte, 20 points), Task II (tableur, 20 points) et Task III (programme C ou Pascal, 10 points). Page de garde verifiee : ORDINARY LEVEL, COMPUTER SCIENCE, 0595, Paper 3, juin 2021, 2h30. Transcrites en neuf fichiers : numero_exercice G1-T1, G1-T2, G1-T3, G2-T1, ..., G3-T3 ; groupes ["GROUP 1"], ["GROUP 2"] ou ["GROUP 3"]. Le sujet n'impose pas expressement de ne traiter qu'une version (le candidat ne passe en pratique qu'un groupe) : non exprimable, regles_choix reste vide. De meme, a la Task III le sujet dit « Select any one of them » (programme C ou Pascal) : non exprimable.

Les filigranes gcerevision.com / Kawlo, les cadres d'en-tete (numero de centre, nom du candidat, « For examiners' use only »), les lignes a completer, les textes fantomes du verso (le papier est translucide) et les artefacts de scanner sont ignores. Le fichier-image « CornerShop » (Group Two, Task II) et les fichiers du bureau ne figurent pas dans le PDF.

Aucun logiciel (traitement de texte, tableur) n'a ete execute : les menus et les etapes sont donnes de memoire (Office recent) et ne sont pas testes. Les formules de tableur ont ete traduites en Python et executees sur les donnees du sujet (totaux, moyennes, calcul des frais, tri). Aucun compilateur C ou Pascal n'est disponible : les programmes du sujet n'ont pas ete compiles, leur logique a ete verifiee par une simulation Python fidele (division entiere et reste, memes entrees, memes sorties) dont les resultats sont recopies dans les corriges.
Aucun corrige officiel n'existe : les reponses sont redigees. Les repartitions de points dans les corriges (« marking idea ») sont indicatives ; les points imprimes du sujet ne sont jamais modifies.

Pascal : les entiers du programme sont declares « integer ». Sur un compilateur a entiers de 16 bits (maximum 32767, cas d'anciens Turbo Pascal ou du mode par defaut de certains compilateurs) une entree comme 45678 (Group One) provoque un depassement ; sur un compilateur a entiers de 32 bits (cas usuel, et int en C) le resultat est celui donne. Le corrige indique la sortie attendue sur une machine a entiers de 32 bits. En Pascal ISO la largeur d'affichage par defaut d'un entier est definie par l'implementation : le corrige suppose l'affichage sans blancs de tete (cas usuel).

Task II, Group Three : les points imprimes (4 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 2 + 4 = 20) correspondent a l'en-tete ; les questions 10 et 11 (save, print) n'ont pas de points. Les marques sont decalees par le texte fantome du verso : lues ligne par ligne (4:2, 5:1, 6:2, 7:1, 8:2, 9:4).

Le tableau de donnees (feuille de calcul sans figure) est recopie en tableau Markdown (colonnes A a G, lignes 2 a 9) : aucune figure n'est produite. Nom du magasin « GreeenShop » recopie tel que lu sur le scan (trois « e » ; lecture a verifier, une faute d'impression du sujet est probable pour « GreenShop »). « Merged cells » de la question 3 lues comme C2:F2 (Supermarkets) et A4:A6 (Items). Question 6 : la formule copiee en G7 donne la moyenne des totaux (3830), valeur non demandee explicitement mais obtenue par la copie decrite. Graphique : B3:F6 ; avec 3 lignes et 4 colonnes de donnees, le tableur place par defaut les lignes (articles) en series et les colonnes (magasins) en categories, conformement a la demande.

questions.enonce_markdown: Launch your spreadsheet software. Enter and format the data as shown.  *[4 marks]*
Select the range containing prices and format them to display numbers as currency.  *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown: Select the prices **C4:F6** (drag from C4 to F6). *Home* tab > *Number* group > **Currency** (or *Format Cells* > *Number* > **Currency**, choose the currency symbol and, for example, no decimal places). The prices are now displayed with the currency symbol, for example 1400 appears as a currency amount. One mark for the right range, one mark for the currency format.

questions.enonce_markdown: Format the fonts in the merged cells as follows: Times New Roman, bold, and 16 point size.  *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown: The merged cells are **C2:F2** (*Supermarkets*) and **A4:A6** (*Items*). Select the first one, hold *Ctrl* and select the second one. In the *Home* tab: font **Times New Roman**, click **B** (Bold), font size **16**. One mark for the font name and bold, one mark for the size (indicative split).

questions.enonce_markdown: Type the label "Total" in Cell B7. Then insert a formula to calculate the total amount for sales by LowCost Supermarket in Cell C7. Copy the formula to corresponding adjacent cells to compute the total sales for the other three supermarkets.  *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Click **B7** and type **Total**. Click **C7** and type `=SUM(C4:C6)` (or `=C4+C5+C6`), press *Enter*. Select C7 and drag the fill handle to the right up to **F7**: the references move along (`=SUM(D4:D6)`, `=SUM(E4:E6)`, `=SUM(F4:F6)`).

Values (Python simulation): **C7 = 3750** (1400 + 1450 + 900), **D7 = 3760** (1200 + 1560 + 1000), **E7 = 3960** (1250 + 1500 + 1210), **F7 = 3850** (1150 + 1500 + 1200).

questions.enonce_markdown: Write in the space below, the formula in Cell F7 after the copy procedure above is done.  *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
**F7:** `=SUM(F4:F6)`

The formula typed in C7 was `=SUM(C4:C6)`; copying it three columns to the right changes the column letter of each reference (relative references), which gives `=SUM(F4:F6)`. The value is 3850.

questions.enonce_markdown: Type the label "Average" in Cell G3. Then insert a formula in cell G4 to calculate the average cost of milk. Copy the formula to the cells in the range G5:G7.  *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Click **G3** and type **Average**. Click **G4** and type `=AVERAGE(C4:F4)` (average of the four prices of milk), press *Enter*. Select G4 and drag the fill handle down to **G7**: the row numbers change (`=AVERAGE(C5:F5)`, `=AVERAGE(C6:F6)`, `=AVERAGE(C7:F7)`).

Values (Python simulation): **G4 = 1250** (5000 / 4), **G5 = 1502.5** (6010 / 4), **G6 = 1077.5** (4310 / 4), **G7 = 3830** (15320 / 4, the average of the four totals of row 7).

questions.enonce_markdown: Write in the space below, the formula in Cell G7 after the copy procedure above is done.  *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
**G7:** `=AVERAGE(C7:F7)`

(Copying `=AVERAGE(C4:F4)` three rows down changes the row number 4 into 7. The value is 3830, the average of the four supermarket totals.)

questions.enonce_markdown: Select the range B3:G7, and format the cells in the range to have single borders.  *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown: Drag from **B3** to **G7** to select the range. *Home* tab > **Borders** > **All Borders** (or *Format Cells* > *Border* > *Outline* and *Inside*, line style: single, thin). A thin single line now surrounds every cell of the range B3:G7. One mark for the right range, one mark for the single borders.

questions.enonce_markdown: Create a column chart using the entries in the range B3:F6, with prices on vertical axis and supermarkets in the horizontal axis. For each supermarket, a separate vertical bar should be drawn for each food item.  *[4 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
1. Select the range **B3:F6** (it includes the empty cell B3, the supermarket names in row 3 and the item names in column B).
2. *Insert* tab > **Column** > **Clustered Column** (2-D).
3. Check the arrangement: the **supermarkets** (LowCost, PicknPay, GreeenShop, Rainbow) must be on the **horizontal axis** and each supermarket must show **three bars**, one for each food item (Milk, Chocolate, Honey), with a legend naming the items. If the chart shows the opposite (items on the horizontal axis), click **Switch Row/Column** in *Chart Design* > *Data*.
4. The **vertical axis** shows the prices (0 to 1800 approximately). Add a chart title (for example *Prices of items in supermarkets*) and axis titles (*Supermarkets*, *Price*) to make it readable.

One mark for the right data range, one for a column chart, one for the right axes and one for the bars grouped by supermarket (indicative split).
*File* > **Save As**, working directory (the *Candidate folder*), file name **Task 2**. No mark is printed for this step.
*File* > **Print** and print one copy of the worksheet and of the chart for the question booklet. No mark is printed for this step.
